description: This file provides functions to handle export operations, including exporting data in various formats, retrieving export history, and scheduling exports. It interacts with an API and provides mock implementations when in mock mode.

methods.name: exportResults({ format = 'csv', data, filename })
methods.description: Exports query results to a file in the specified format, either using client-side mock logic or by calling an API endpoint and triggering a download.

methods.name: getExportHistory({ page = 1, pageSize = 10 } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves paginated export history data, returning mock data if in mock mode or fetching from API otherwise.

methods.name: scheduleExport({ format, query, schedule, recipients })
methods.description: Schedules a periodic data export with specified parameters, returning mock data in mock mode or calling an API endpoint otherwise.

ctags.name: exportResults
ctags.pattern: /^export async function exportResults({ format = 'csv', data, filename }) {$/

ctags.name: scheduleExport
ctags.pattern: /^export async function scheduleExport({ format, query, schedule, recipients }) {$/
